prompt.garment: an oversized drop-shoulder t-shirt in 185gsm 100% combed cotton single jersey, {COR}, relaxed straight roomy body, dropped shoulders with the seam sitting a couple of centimeters down the upper arm, wide short sleeves ending just above the elbow with a double-stitched hem, narrow 2x1 ribbed crew neck lying flat and round, straight double-stitched hem below the hip, smooth matte cotton surface, opaque
prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: mid-weight 185gsm 100% combed cotton single jersey with a soft, smooth, matte hand and only a faint natural cotton sheen; it has enough body to keep a loose oversized volume without clinging, yet it is clearly lighter than a heavyweight tee — it falls from the chest in a few soft vertical folds and forms gentle ripples just above the hem. Narrow 2x1 ribbed collar with a closed ring finish and shoulder-to-shoulder tape keeps a clean round shape; dropped shoulder seam on the upper arm; chain-stitched seams; double-needle hems at sleeves and body; anti-twist finish keeps side seams hanging straight. Movement: light and fluid — sleeves swing and crease softly when the arm moves, and where a hand touches the fabric it forms small soft folds rather than thick rounded ones.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 76 cm ending below the hip and covering the jeans waistband, flat chest width 58 cm giving a loose straight body with visible ease, shoulder width 50 cm so the shoulder seam drops about 2 cm past each shoulder point, sleeve length 22 cm ending just above the elbow with a wide opening.
